ella: quick heads-up — taking a preflight SLO snapshot for the EU change window at 06:00 UTC. who should I include?
noah: p95 per-route, p99 embed, 5xx rate, kv-cache miss%, kernel-fallback count, gpu queue depth.
ravi: add reranker 4xx rate and model-variant fallback counts. saw small blips last night.
sre-bot: SIM_ALERT: embed-route p95 +32% vs baseline (115ms -> 151ms) in the last 30m. sample trace=trace-eu-2f2.
ella: did staging take any runtime variants?
noah: quantize-v2.1.4-rc3 deployed to staging ~03:10 UTC. no prod rollout.
ravi: pulling trace logs now — looks like kernel fallbacks on gpu-12 and increased KV latency correlated with the spike; a smattering of 502s in the tail.
ella: suggestion: hold the EU traffic shift and pin eu-embed to v2.1.4-rc2 for the window. run kernel regression suite overnight on rc3.
noah: +1. update release notes: "EU change window: hold; eu-embed pinned to v2.1.4-rc2 pending kernel regression on rc3 (RED-4219)."
deploy-bot: action logged by @ella: pin route=eu-embed -> version=v2.1.4-rc2; reason="staging p95 drift with rc3 kernel fallbacks"; ticket=RED-4219.
sre-bot: quick smoke on pinned version (2k samples): p95=118ms, 5xx=0.07%, kv-miss=2.2% -> smoke OK.
ella: plan: no traffic shift until 05:00 UTC re-eval. ramp plan if green: 10% -> 30% -> 100%. abort if p95 > 1.25x baseline OR 5xx > 0.5% OR kernel-fallback-rate > 2x baseline.
ravi: I'll run the regression matrix overnight and post results in RED-4219. tagging oncall @noah pls monitor.
noah: ack.
ella: adding unpin/rollback cmds to release notes: `deploy-bot pin remove --route eu-embed --version v2.1.4-rc2` and `deploy-bot rollback --route eu-embed --to-version v2.1.4-rc2 --force`.
sre-bot: final: will post 04:30 snapshot and 05:00 go/no-go.
noah: thanks all.
(END)
